parameters.query: SELECT id, content, role, conversation_id, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) as similarity_score FROM messages WHERE tenant_id = $2 AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) > 0.8 ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT 5

SELECT title, content, category, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) as similarity_score FROM knowledge_base WHERE tenant_id = $2 AND is_active = true AND 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) > 0.7 ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT 3
